description: This file defines two internal widget classes in Flutter: _AnimatedResetBoardButton and _AnimatedResetScoresButton. These widgets provide animated buttons for resetting the game board and scores in a Tic Tac Toe Flutter frontend, interacting with a GameState model and styled with custom theme constants.

classes.name: _AnimatedResetBoardButton
classes.description: A stateful widget wrapping an animated button to reset the game board.

classes.name: _AnimatedResetScoresButton
classes.description: A stateful widget providing an animated button to reset game scores.

methods.name: _AnimatedResetBoardButtonState._onPressed
methods.description: Handles press event to reset the game board via GameState.

methods.name: _AnimatedResetScoresButtonState._onPressed
methods.description: Handles press event to reset game scores via GameState.
